user.title: Heizwerk
user.description: House-wide sensors. Add rooms afterwards with 'Add room'.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Outdoor sensor for the summer lock and the airing time. Recommended; without it there is no summer lock.
data_description.season_entity: Heating is locked while this entity is off. Optional; without it heating is always allowed.

summer_lock.name: Summer lock
summer_lock.description: Stops heating in warm weather, independent of the heating period.

data_description.summer_lock_temperature: Locks heating when it is at least this warm outside. Default 16 °C; 0 disables the summer lock.
data_description.summer_lock_minutes: The outdoor temperature must stay above the limit this long. Default 10 min.

climate.name: Room climate
climate.description: Outdoor values for dew point and airing recommendation.

data_description.outdoor_humidity: Used for the outdoor dew point: airing is only recommended when the outside air is drier. Optional.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Outdoor sensor for the summer lock and the airing time. Recommended; without it there is no summer lock.
data_description.season_entity: Heating is locked while this entity is off. Optional; without it heating is always allowed.

summer_lock.name: Summer lock
summer_lock.description: Stops heating in warm weather, independent of the heating period.

data_description.summer_lock_temperature: Locks heating when it is at least this warm outside. Default 16 °C; 0 disables the summer lock.
data_description.summer_lock_minutes: The outdoor temperature must stay above the limit this long. Default 10 min.

climate.name: Room climate
climate.description: Outdoor values for dew point and airing recommendation.

data_description.outdoor_humidity: Used for the outdoor dew point: airing is only recommended when the outside air is drier. Optional.

data_description.name: Shown on the card; the entity becomes climate.heizwerk_ plus the room name (e.g. climate.heizwerk_bad).
data_description.trvs: All thermostats of the room; they all get the same set-point.
data_description.temperature_sensor: External room sensor, strongly recommended. Without it the thermostats' own readings are averaged.
data_description.observe_only: Computes and shows the planned commands but sends nothing. Default on; keep it on while the old heating control still runs in parallel.

schedule.name: Schedule & resume
schedule.description: Your scheduler (Zeitwerk, Scheduler, automation) sets the room via climate.set_temperature. Here: plan display and what 'Resume' does.

data_description.zeitwerk_plan: Optional, detected automatically: the Zeitwerk plan whose profile actions set this room. Only used for display (profile, day band, until).
data_description.resume_action: What happens on 'Resume' and when 1 h / 3 h run out. Empty with a detected Zeitwerk plan: zeitwerk.resume for that plan. Empty without plan: Resume is hidden. For Scheduler e.g. scheduler.run_action with the schedule switch.

room_climate.name: Room climate
room_climate.description: Humidity, wall humidity (mold risk) and airing recommendation.

data_description.humidity_sensor: Room humidity for dew point and airing recommendation. Optional.
data_description.mold_sensor: e.g. sensor.claude_schimmel_bad from HA's mold indicator; its value is used directly as wall humidity. Optional.
data_description.wall_temperature_sensor: Temperature sensor (°C/°F) on the coldest wall surface; gives the wall humidity (mold risk). Hidden when a mold indicator is set. Optional.
data_description.humidity_threshold: Airing is recommended above this room humidity. Default 60 %; bathrooms 65–70 %.

windows_locks.name: Windows & locks
windows_locks.description: Window contacts, additional locks, summer lock of this room and what happens while heating is locked.

data_description.windows: Heating is locked while a window is open. Optional.
data_description.window_open_delay: Delay before an open window locks heating. Default 30 s.
data_description.window_close_delay: Delay before heating resumes after closing. Default 10 s.
data_description.lock_entities: Heating is locked while one of these is on, e.g. a maintenance switch. Not for holidays or absence, that is Zeitwerk's job.
data_description.lock_mode: Off relies on the thermostat's built-in frost protection (fine for Sonoff TRVZB). Default off.
data_description.frost_temperature: Set-point while locked in frost mode. Default 7 °C.
data_description.outdoor_limit: Outdoor temperature from which this room is locked. Empty = house value from the Heizwerk options; 0 = no summer lock for this room.

regulation.name: Regulation (advanced)
regulation.description: How the set-point and the room temperature reach the thermostats. Use either sending the room temperature or offset, never both. With two-point a knob turn is always reset.

data_description.regulation: Set-point: thermostat regulates itself (recommended). Offset: adds thermostat reading minus room sensor, only without sending the room temperature. Two-point: valve open/closed by hysteresis; a knob turn is then always reset.
data_description.send_temperature: Heizwerk finds each thermostat's external temperature input (number.…_external_temperature_input) and sends the room sensor value (only with a room sensor). Sonoff TRVZB: measuring source remote_temperature in Zigbee2MQTT. Default on.
data_description.correction: Added to the set-point sent to the thermostats, e.g. -0.5 K. Default 0; keep 0 while sending the room temperature.
data_description.hysteresis_low: Heat when the room is this much below the target. Default 0.5 K.
data_description.hysteresis_high: Off from target + value; negative = off before the target (against overshoot). Default 0 K.
data_description.heat_setpoint: Sent to the thermostat while heating so the valve opens fully. Default 24 °C.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Minimum run/pause of the valve; 0 = off. Windows, locks and room off still act immediately.
data_description.min_off_minutes: Minimum run/pause of the valve; 0 = off. Windows, locks and room off still act immediately.
data_description.trv_manual: Adopt: a change at the thermostat is a manual override like on the card (default). Reset: Heizwerk sets its own value again. Two-point always resets.
data_description.knob_min_temperature: Values set at the thermostat below this are discarded. Empty = automatic: lowest Zeitwerk profile value, else minimum set-point.

limits.name: Set-points & limits
limits.description: Initial set-point and allowed set-point range.

data_description.default_target: Used until the first set-point arrives from your schedule or the card. Default 20 °C.

error.name_exists: A room with this name already exists.
error.offset_with_external: Offset regulation and sending the room temperature compensate twice. Use regulation 'Set-point' or switch off sending the room temperature.
error.heizwerk_entity: Heizwerk entities are not allowed here (Heizwerk would control itself).
error.invalid_action: The resume action is invalid. Check the action configuration.
error.not_temperature: The wall temperature sensor must measure °C or °F. For a mold indicator (%) use the mold indicator field.
error.two_point_needs_sensor: Two-point regulation needs a room temperature sensor; the thermostat's own reading next to the radiator would switch off too early.
error.hysteresis_too_small: Two-point regulation: hysteresis below plus above must be at least 0.2 K, otherwise the valve switches constantly.

options.two_point: Two-point (valve open/closed, like the previous automation)

set_manual.name: Set manual target
set_manual.description: Overrides the planned set-point of a room until the next Zeitwerk change or for a duration.

sync.name: Sync thermostats
sync.description: Re-evaluates the room and sends pending commands now (nothing in observe-only mode).

target_entity_removed.title: Heizwerk: Zeitwerk target of room {room} is no longer used
target_entity_removed.description:
Since Heizwerk 0.4 the schedule writes to the room entity directly. The configured Zeitwerk target `{entity}` is ignored.

To switch:
1. Change the profile actions of the room's Zeitwerk plan to `climate.set_temperature` targeting `{climate}`.
2. Open the room in the Heizwerk integration and save it once – then this notice disappears.

sensor_select_not_remote.title: Heizwerk: thermostat {trv} does not measure with the room sensor
sensor_select_not_remote.description: The measuring source {select} is "{state}" instead of remote_temperature. Set it back in Zigbee2MQTT or HA (select.select_option with remote_temperature). Heizwerk does not change it itself.

trv_rejects_command.title: Heizwerk: thermostat {trv} does not take over the command
trv_rejects_command.description:
Room {room}: {trv} did not take over {command} three times within 10 minutes, or dropped it again right away. Heizwerk pauses repeating until the 10-minute window ends and then tries again.

Check the thermostat's radio link, battery and child lock. This notice disappears once the thermostat keeps the value for 2 minutes.
